nodes.name: tool-output.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the Effect Schema content types for V2 tool output: TextContent and FileContent classes combined into a type-tagged Content union, plus a free-form Structured record schema.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Schema.Class generics pattern (`class X extends Schema.Class<X>(...)`) and Schema.toTaggedUnion to build a discriminated union keyed on the `type` literal.

nodes.name: TextContent
nodes.summary: Effect Schema class for plain-text tool output carrying a single `text` field tagged as type "text".

nodes.name: FileContent
nodes.summary: Effect Schema class for file-based tool output with uri, mime type, and optional display name, tagged as type "file".

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Effect service managing git worktrees for opencode projects: generates unique branch/directory names, creates and bootstraps worktrees (including project start-command execution), lists, removes (with fsmonitor shutdown and directory cleanup), and resets worktrees to the default branch including submodule sweeps. Also declares a NamedError taxonomy, worktree.ready/failed bus events, and app/default layer wiring.
nodes.languageNotes: Effect-gen layer pattern: the service implementation is a closure of `Effect.fn` generators returned via `Service.of(...)`, with `Context.Service` tag declaration and `Layer.provide` composition for dependency injection.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Effect Context.Service tag for the Worktree service, typed against the Interface contract (makeWorktreeInfo, createFromInfo, create, list, remove, reset).

nodes.name: failedRemoves
nodes.summary: Extracts directory paths from git `clean -ffdx` "warning: failed to remove ..." stderr lines so the sweep logic can prune locked entries and retry.

nodes.name: parseWorktreeList
nodes.summary: Parses `git worktree list --porcelain` output into entries of path and branch by folding lines starting with "worktree " and "branch ".

nodes.name: makeWorktreeInfo
nodes.summary: Validates the project is a git repo, creates the per-project worktree root under the global data directory, and delegates to the candidate generator to reserve a unique name/branch/directory triple.

nodes.name: boot
nodes.summary: Populates a freshly created worktree via `git reset --hard`, bootstraps an opencode instance in it through the instance store, emits worktree.ready/failed bus events, and runs project plus extra start scripts.

nodes.name: createFromInfo
nodes.summary: Sets up a worktree from prepared Info (branch creation and sandbox registration) then forks the boot sequence into the service scope so creation returns immediately.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Public create entry point: reserves a unique worktree name (or slugifies the requested one) and runs createFromInfo with the optional start command.

nodes.name: list
nodes.summary: Lists all non-primary git worktrees with canonicalized (case-normalized on Windows) directories and branch names, returning an empty list for non-git projects.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Removes a worktree: stops the fsmonitor daemon, runs `git worktree remove --force` with stale-entry verification, force-deletes the directory with retries, and deletes the associated branch.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Resets a worktree to the project's default branch: fetches the remote ref, hard-resets, sweeps untracked files (with a prune-and-retry pass for locked paths), recursively resets and cleans submodules, verifies a clean status, and re-runs start scripts.

nodes.name: sweep
nodes.summary: Runs `git clean -ffdx` and, when git reports paths it failed to remove, prunes those directories and retries the clean once.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient type stub that pulls in the `sst` module types; required for the SST environment integration to typecheck.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Manifest for @opencode-ai/plugin exposing three source-TS entry points (root, ./tool, ./tui), with the SDK as a workspace dependency and the @opentui packages as optional peer dependencies so server-only plugins need no TUI toolchain.

nodes.name: publish.ts
nodes.summary: Publish script for @opencode-ai/plugin: typechecks with tsc, skips if the version already exists on npm, otherwise rewrites the exports map from ./src to ./dist paths, packs, publishes under the release channel tag, and restores package.json afterwards.
nodes.languageNotes: Mutates package.json in place before `bun pm pack` and restores the original text in a `finally` block, so the working tree is never left pointing at dist outputs.

nodes.name: example-workspace.ts
nodes.summary: Reference example of the experimental workspace adapter API: registers a "folder" workspace type that provisions blank directories under /tmp, with configure/create/remove/target lifecycle methods.

nodes.name: FolderWorkspacePlugin
nodes.summary: Plugin entry function that registers a folder-backed WorkspaceAdapter computing a random directory in configure, mkdir-ing it in create, rm-ing it in remove, and exposing it as a local workspace target.

nodes.name: example.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal plugin example demonstrating custom tool registration: returns a Hooks object with one zod-arg tool that echoes its input.

nodes.name: ExamplePlugin
nodes.summary: Plugin implementation that contributes a single custom tool ("mytool") defined via the tool() helper with a zod string argument and a greeting execute function.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: The public server plugin API for @opencode-ai/plugin: defines PluginInput (SDK client, project, Bun shell handle, workspace registry), the Plugin/Hooks contracts (event, config, tool, auth with OAuth/API prompt flows, provider models, chat.message/params/headers, permission.ask, tool.execute.before/after, shell.env, and experimental message/system/compaction transform hooks), and the WorkspaceAdapter interface. Also re-exports the tool helper.
nodes.languageNotes: Entirely a type-surface module: hooks use a mutable-`output` interception pattern where plugins mutate the output object in place rather than returning a new value.

nodes.name: shell.ts
nodes.summary: Hand-written type declarations mirroring Bun's shell API — the `$` template tag, BunShell, BunShellPromise, BunShellOutput, and BunShellError — so plugins get typed shell access (passed as `input.$`) without a hard dependency on bun-types.

nodes.name: tool.ts
nodes.summary: Custom-tool definition helper for plugins: the identity function tool() captures zod-arg inference for execute(), and the module exports ToolContext (session/agent/abort/metadata/ask) and ToolResult types.
nodes.languageNotes: The `tool()` function returns its input unchanged purely for type inference, and exposes `tool.schema = z` so examples can define args without a separate zod import.

nodes.name: tool
nodes.summary: Identity helper that types a plugin tool definition (description, zod args shape, async execute receiving inferred args and a ToolContext) and returns it unchanged.

nodes.name: tui.ts
nodes.summary: The public TUI plugin API for @opencode-ai/plugin: re-exports OpenTUI renderer/keymap primitives and declares the full TuiPluginApi surface — dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt/select), slot registration, theme and KV stores, session state views, keymap and route registration, toasts, plugin lifecycle management, and the deprecated v1 command API. Consumed by TUI extension authors via the package's ./tui export.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines a curated re-export barrel over @opentui/core, @opentui/keymap, and @opentui/keymap/extras with a large hand-maintained type surface; the `Frozen<T>` recursive mapped type makes the whole TUI config view deeply readonly.

nodes.name: createBindingLookup
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper that instantiates the @opentui/keymap binding lookup for the TUI's Renderable/KeyEvent types, defaulting to an empty config.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient type stub that pulls in the `sst` module types for the plugin package.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for @opencode-ai/plugin extending @tsconfig/node22: compiles src/ to dist/ with declarations, nodenext module resolution, and DOM libs (for the OpenTUI-facing types).

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Manifest for @opencode-ai/script, the shared release-tooling helper package: depends only on semver and exports its source entry directly.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Shared release-scripting helpers: validates the running Bun version against the root packageManager field, derives the release channel (latest vs preview branch), computes the next npm version via registry lookup or major/minor/patch bump, loads the team members allowlist from .github/TEAM_MEMBERS, and exports everything as the Script singleton used by all package publish scripts.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses top-level await with IIFE async functions to compute channel/version at import time, exposed through getter properties on the exported Script object.

nodes.name: sst-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated SST ambient type stub that pulls in the `sst` module types for the script package.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for @opencode-ai/script extending @tsconfig/bun with ESNext and DOM libs, relaxing noUncheckedIndexedAccess for the script's index arithmetic.

nodes.name: example.ts
nodes.summary: SDK usage example that boots a local opencode server via createOpencode(), then creates one session per file matched by a glob and prompts the agent to write tests for every public function in each file.

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: SDK generator script: runs `bun dev generate` in the opencode package to emit openapi.json, generates the v2 TypeScript types and fetch client via @hey-api/openapi-ts into src/v2/gen, patches the generated client's data-style error return and TData|undefined types, then compiles with tsc into dist/.
nodes.languageNotes: Post-generation patching via exact string replace on the generated client.gen.ts/types.gen.ts is load-bearing: regenerating without it reintroduces the `undefined`-return bug in the data response style.

nodes.name: publish.ts
nodes.summary: Publish script for @opencode-ai/sdk: skips already-published versions, recursively rewrites the exports map from ./src to ./dist import/types pairs, packs and publishes under the release channel tag, and restores package.json in a finally block.

nodes.name: transformExports
nodes.summary: Recursively maps a package.json exports object, converting string ./src/*.ts paths to { import: .js, types: .d.ts } dist entries while preserving nested condition objects.

nodes.name: error-interceptor.ts
nodes.summary: Error normalization for the SDK client: wraps decoded non-2xx POJO bodies into real Error instances with useful messages (NamedError-shaped data.message first) when callers opt into throwOnError, preserving the parsed body and status under .cause, while leaving the result-tuple error path untouched.

nodes.name: wrapClientError
nodes.summary: Interceptor that converts object/string error bodies into Error instances with the best available message (data.message, message, name, or a request/response description), falling back to an explicit empty-body/network-error message.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Root entry of @opencode-ai/sdk: re-exports the entire v2 surface plus the data namespace, and provides createOpencode() which boots a local server and returns a connected client pair.

nodes.name: createOpencode
nodes.summary: Convenience factory that starts a local opencode server (createOpencodeServer) and returns it bundled with a client pointed at the server's URL.

nodes.name: process.ts
nodes.summary: Child-process lifecycle helpers for the SDK: stop() kills process trees cross-platform (taskkill /T /F on Windows) and bindAbort() ties an AbortSignal to process termination with listener cleanup on exit/error. Duplicated from the opencode package to avoid a workspace dependency cycle.

nodes.name: stop
nodes.summary: Terminates a child process if still running, using Windows taskkill with tree-kill semantics before falling back to proc.kill().

nodes.name: bindAbort
nodes.summary: Registers an abort handler that stops the process and invokes a callback, with symmetric listener removal on either abort or process exit/error, and immediate firing if the signal is already aborted.

nodes.name: client.ts
nodes.summary: V2 SDK client factory: wraps the generated hey-api client with a no-timeout fetch, directory/workspace header injection, a request interceptor that moves those headers into query params for GET/HEAD requests, an HTML-response guard against version-mismatched servers, and error wrapping via wrapClientError.
nodes.languageNotes: Header-to-query-param rewriting lets GET requests stay cacheable/bookmarkable while POSTs keep routing context in headers; the pick() helper tolerates both raw and encodeURIComponent forms of the fallback.

nodes.name: rewrite
nodes.summary: Request interceptor that, for GET/HEAD only, copies the x-opencode-directory and x-opencode-workspace headers into directory/workspace query params (when absent) and strips the headers from the rewritten request.

nodes.name: createOpencodeClient
nodes.summary: Constructs the OpencodeClient from the generated SDK: installs a timeout-free default fetch, encodes directory and workspace targeting headers, then registers the rewrite, HTML-detection, and wrapClientError interceptors.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: SDK data helpers for fabricating user messages locally: message.user() assembles a UserMessage info plus fully-linked parts, filling in placeholder IDs, timestamps, and session/message back-references.

nodes.name: message.user
nodes.summary: Builds a user message pair from stripped input: assigns a placeholder id and created time to the UserMessage and stamps each part with id, messageID, and sessionID back-references.
